reason.en: The official summary says Proposition 73 "Prohibits public officials using and candidates accepting public funds for purpose of seeking elective office."

sourceTitle.en: California Ballot Pamphlet, Primary Election, June 7, 1988: Proposition 73, Official Title and Summary (UC Law SF California Ballot Propositions database)

summary.en: Limited yearly contributions to candidates, limited gifts and honoraria to elected officials, banned newsletters and mass mailings at public expense, and barred public officials and candidates from using or accepting public funds to seek elective office.

title.en: Campaign Funding. Contribution Limits. Prohibition of Public Funding. Initiative Statute.
